latHint: Think a rascal in a deck of cards - not a car lifter.
pivHint: A JACK lifts a car - but in a deck of cards the JACK is also called the ______.
winText: Rascal. JACK was the pivot - a car lift to a card KNAVE.
lossText: KNAVE - a rogue, and the card between ten and queen. JACK was the pivot: car JACK to the card JACK.
